issues: The causal link '이에 따라' is dropped, so the output no longer says the backup duty and staging check follow from the possible data integrity issue.
The subject '백업이' was dropped from '백업이 실패한 경우', so '실패하면' could mean the backup failing or the check failing.
The original allows '초기화됩니다' to refer to either the servers or their memory, and the rewrite silently resolves it to the servers by adding '이 두 서버는'.
The subject '백업이' was dropped from '백업이 실패한 경우에는', so '실패하면' can now be read as the check failing rather than the backup failing.
'백업이 실패한 경우' was shortened to '실패하면', which drops the subject '백업이', so the sentence can also read as the check (확인) failing instead of the backup failing.
